source_summary: Exported Lovable TanStack Start streaming platform (movies/TV catalog via TMDB, browse/search/details, watchlist, watch parties with PIN-protected rooms, guest playback with ads, admin panel: users/servers/videos/ads/catalog/settings/audit log, TMDB catalog sync).
